messages.subject: For Katharina Jenny | Corporate affairs and stakeholder execution across Antofagasta growth
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Orozco,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Katharina Jenny, Vice President of Corporate Affairs.

Antofagasta's next phase of copper growth depends on more than project economics. Large mining districts, infrastructure, regulators and host communities require disciplined corporate-affairs execution that keeps institutional relationships and operating commitments moving together.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major gold-mining operation. I routinely translate external requirements into accountable actions across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement and technical teams.

I would value a conversation about where this country-facing experience might support Antofagasta's corporate affairs, government relations, stakeholder strategy or regional leadership priorities as the Group advances its growth portfolio. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
